about.title: About Me
about.intro: Fullstack Developer (C# / .NET · TypeScript / React) with 5+ years of experience. I build robust web applications for business automation, architect systems, and deliver end-to-end user interfaces.
about.main: I transitioned into IT from logistics. I designed and deployed an 'Electronic Customs Warehouse' system from scratch, cutting operational costs by 50% and fully automating all accounting.
about.highlight: I bring this experience to the web by building automation modules and AI tools for document processing, eliminating routine tasks and spreadsheets.
about.conclusion: A deep understanding of business processes allows me to combine a solid .NET backend, modern React interfaces, and AI technologies into working products.

projects.title: Projects
projects.intro: For me, projects are not only about learning and finding solutions, but also about creating things that truly help people and businesses. This real value is what makes them important. Here are some of my projects:

list.title: Personal Ops Center
list.description: A fullstack microservices platform with a Next.js dashboard and two production services: Identity Service (JWT auth) and Doc Intelligence (asynchronous AI document processing). Uses secure BFF proxy routes with httpOnly cookies. Deployed publicly on Railway.

list.title: DocSense API (.NET)
list.description: A backend API for intelligent document processing and AI-powered analysis. Built with ASP.NET Core and EF Core, featuring file upload handling, background job processing, usage limits, and Swagger documentation for easy integration and testing.

list.title: DocSense AI (MVP)
list.description: An intelligent document analysis system. Built with a modular architecture, it leverages AI for insights and Redis for high-performance data caching. Includes full Swagger documentation.
